RESOLVED: Dear Ms. Whitfield,

Re: Claim CLM-550193 for MRI brain w/o contrast on August 27

Thank you for reaching out to us about the denial of your MRI claim. I apologize for any inconvenience this has caused. The denial reason was "prior authorization not on file". I understand that your doctor ordered the MRI for your migraines.

You have the right to appeal this decision. You may file a first-level appeal within 180 days of the denial notice date. To do so, your ordering provider (Dr. L. Okonjo) may submit a retrospective authorization request with clinical documentation supporting medical necessity. 

The 180-day appeal window for your claim started on the date of the denial notice. I have calculated the exact deadline for you: [insert date 180 days from denial notice date]. Please note that standard appeals are decided within 30 calendar days.

I am attaching the appeal form (FORM-APP-1) to this message for your convenience. If you need any help with the appeal process or have questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to me.

Sincerely,
ARIA
Meridian Health Plan Member Services
